name: IHEP-JINR
full_name: IHEP-JINR neutrino detector at the U-70 accelerator
summary: The joint IHEP-JINR neutrino detector at Protvino studied neutrino-nucleon interactions and oscillation or heavy-neutrino signatures in U-70 beams, including dedicated beam-dump configurations.
physics_targets: Neutrino-nucleon structure functions at low momentum transfer
Electron-neutrino disappearance and heavy neutral leptons
Prompt neutrino production in beam-dump running
detection_principle: A massive segmented calorimetric target with tracking and muon analysis reconstructed charged-current and neutral-current interactions. Beam configuration and event topology separated muon and electron components and supported structure-function measurements.
